notes.title: HURRY UP!
notes.content: [p]Are you ready to face the cutest rage game ever? Get Unblock at 50% off this week and take on the challenge of the cubic world![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: VER 1.0.1 MINOR BUG FIXING
A NEW skin selection level is coming to Unblock!
notes.content:
Hey, guess what, Unblock has a skin selection level now!

There are over 40 different skins with all kinds of styles and colors, from simple color swaps to chakra, expanding morphing lasers, and even a few loosely inspired by classic video game characters.

We can't wait to see which styles you'll choose!

notes.title: Mark your calendars, Unblock arrives on May 6th!
